summary: Complaints centre on land and revenue grievances at Behat tehsil and unsafe travel on the Delhi-Yamunotri highway, while canal irrigation, mango and guava orchards and the local CHC are the main points of appreciation, though local evidence is thin and several items are inference.

positives.english: Canal water reaches our fields, so the crops grow well
positives.hindi: नहर का पानी है, इसलिए यहां के खेतों में फसल अच्छी होती है
positives.basis: Western Yamuna Canal irrigates most of the town's arable land (Wikipedia, Behat town article; undated page, no specific date given).

positives.english: Mango and guava orchards are our pride and our livelihood
positives.hindi: आम और अमरूद के बाग़ ही यहां की पहचान और रोज़ी-रोटी हैं
positives.basis: Agriculture has been the main focus for about 200 years, with mango orchards the mainstay; the town is known for guavas (Wikipedia, Behat town article; undated).

positives.english: Our local craftsmen make brass bells and wrought-iron goods
positives.hindi: पीतल की घंटियां और लोहे का सामान यहां के कारीगर बनाते हैं
positives.basis: The article lists brass bells and wrought iron handicrafts as local products (Wikipedia, Behat town article; undated).

positives.english: *The Delhi-Yamunotri highway makes travel to Saharanpur easy
positives.hindi: *दिल्ली-यमुनोत्री हाईवे पर होने से सहारनपुर आना-जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: the town is on NH-709B, about 30 km north of Saharanpur (Wikipedia, Behat town article). The 'easy travel' point is not stated in any source reached.

positives.english: *Behat's CHC gives first treatment in an emergency before referral
positives.hindi: *बेहट सीएचसी में इमरजेंसी का पहला इलाज मिल जाता है, फिर ज़िला अस्पताल भेजते हैं
positives.basis: Inference: based on one fatal crash report (Dec 2021) in which injured were taken to the Behat CHC, given first aid and referred to the district hospital. Single incident, not a general finding.

negatives.english: Officials take bribes and poor families lose their land in Behat tehsil
negatives.hindi: तहसील में रिश्वत चलती है, गरीब की ज़मीन भू-माफिया के नाम चढ़ जाती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Feb 2025): Dalit and Muslim women of Begpur Naugawan village in Behat tehsil locked the tehsil gate and protested. They allege 100+ families on about 14 bigha were evicted after the Naib Tehsildar and Halka Lekhpal allegedly took money from a land mafia. These are the women's allegations, not established findings. No official response found.

negatives.english: *Speeding vehicles on the highway near Behat put people at risk
negatives.hindi: *बेहट के पास हाईवे पर तेज़ रफ़्तार गाड़ियां जान का खतरा बनी रहती हैं
negatives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (10 Dec 2021) reports a fatal three-bike collision on the Delhi-Yamunotri highway near Babail Bujurg, Behat, with the injured taken to the Behat CHC. The report does not mention speed or road conditions, and it is from 2021, so it is not recent.

negatives.english: *Drinking water is hard to get in many Behat villages
negatives.hindi: *बेहट के कई गांवों में पीने का पानी मुश्किल से मिलता है
negatives.basis: Inference: no Behat-specific water report was opened. A Lok Sabha record found in search (eparlib.nic.in) mentions drinking water scarcity in Behat tehsil blocks, but that page could not be fetched, so it is not cited. The source below supports only the general neglect point.

negatives.english: Behat has seen little development in seventy years
negatives.hindi: बेहट में सत्तर सालों में विकास बहुत कम हुआ है
negatives.basis: Wikipedia (Behat town article, undated): 'the government has neglected the area; as a result, Behat has made little progress in last 70 years.' This is the article's editorial claim, not a voter statement.

negatives.english: *Mango growers do not get a fair price or enough support for their crop
negatives.hindi: *आम के बागवानों को फसल का सही दाम और मदद नहीं मिलती
negatives.basis: Inference: Wikipedia says mango orchards are the town's mainstay, but no price or support complaint was found in any source reached.

notes: Identity confirmed from the Wikipedia UP constituency list (No. 1 Behat, district Saharanpur, reserved status None, 372,305 electors) and the Behat constituency page (MLA Umar Ali Khan, SP, since 10 Mar 2022). Search budget ran out after about 16 WebSearch calls, so coverage is thin. Only one Behat-specific 2025 report was found (Amar Ujala, 21 Feb 2025). The Dec 2021 accident report is older than the preferred 2024-2026 window. Not used: a Patrika report (1 Aug 2026) on an SP MLC clash during an election procession, which is political and electoral, and Amar Ujala sugarcane-dues stories from Bareilly and Shamli, which are not about Behat. A Lok Sabha record on water scarcity in Behat tehsil (Muzaffarabad and Sidhauli Kadim blocks) could not be fetched (DNS failure), so it is not cited. Negatives 3 and 5 and positives 4 and 5 are inference and need field checks. Water, road condition, stray cattle, monkeys, electricity and sugarcane dues in Behat were not confirmed by any source. Wikipedia's Behat article gives population as 8,574 in the infobox and 20,474 in the census text, so it is internally inconsistent. Ranking is a judgment based on how strongly each item is documented.
